title: Using finger spaces between words
examples: Why do I need spaces between words?
How big is a finger space?

explain.say: Look at the board. The same sentence is written 2 ways. Which side is easier to read?
Look at the squashed side. All the words touch each other. It is hard to see where one word ends. Can you find the word dog?
Now look at the side with finger spaces. Each word has a gap after it: I, like, my, dog. This side is easier to read. Can you count the words?
Here is how to make a finger space. Write a word. Put your pointing finger on the paper right after it. Start the next word after your finger. Can you try it with your name?

explain.say: Keep going: word, finger, word, finger. Some people use a small stick as a spacer. That works too. Today, write a short sentence with finger spaces.

faq.a: A finger space is the gap you leave between words. It is about as wide as your finger.

faq.q: How do I make a finger space?
faq.a: Write a word, put your finger on the paper right after it, then start the next word after your finger.
asks: How big is a finger space?

faq.a: Spaces show where one word ends and the next begins. Without them, writing is hard to read, even for you.

faq.q: What if my finger gets in the way?
faq.a: Some writers, often left-handed ones, find their finger gets in the way. You can use a lolly stick, a pencil or just a small gap you can see instead.
asks: I am left-handed and finger spaces are hard

faq.a: A spacer is a little stick, like a lolly stick, that you put after each word to make the gap. A grown-up can help you make one.

facts: English and many other languages leave a space between words when they are written.
Very old writing in Latin and Greek was often written with no spaces between words.

quiz.say: Think about finger spaces. Where do they go?
quiz.show: Where does a finger space go?

options.show: At the top of the page
options.say: At the top of the page

quiz.why: A finger space goes between words. It shows where each word ends.

wrong.0: The letters in a word stay close together.
wrong.2: Finger spaces go along the line of writing.

quiz.say: Listen: Mei has a red bike. How many words are there?
quiz.show: Mei has a red bike. How many words?
quiz.why: Mei, has, a, red, bike. That is 5 words.

wrong.0: Point to each word as you count, and you find more than 3.
wrong.1: 4 leaves out 1 word, so point and count again.
